metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Two targets in win
metadata.description: Whiteheart caught one of his two targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 23-19 win over the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart played 27 of the Browns' 58 offensive snaps in Sunday's contest. The tight end also contributed on 15 special-teams snaps. Whiteheart is the second option at tight end behind Harold Fanin but plays a significant role in the team's run game.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Back with Browns
metadata.description: Whiteheart is slated to re-sign with the Browns on Monday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart wasn't tendered by Cleveland by the early March deadline, but he's now re-upped with the team. While suiting up for all 17 regular-season contests with the team in 2025, Whiteheart contributed on special teams and as a blocker on offense. He stands to reprise a similar depth role during the 2026 campaign.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart Returns to the Browns
metadata.description: The Cleveland Browns re-signed tight end Blake Whiteheart to an undisclosed deal on Monday, according to Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Sports. The deal is most likely for just one season, bringing Whiteheart back for his third year in Cleveland. The 26-year-old has not been on the fantasy football radar in his three seasons in the NFL, catching just eight of 15 targets for 55 yards and one touchdown in 30 games (six starts). He went undrafted out of Wake Forest before debuting in the NFL in 2023 with the Arizona Cardinals. Whiteheart had a career-high six catches for 51 yards and his only touchdown in 11 games (two starts) in his first year in Cleveland in 2024. He will return to block on offense while also contributing on special teams. David Njoku isn't going to return in free agency, but Harold Fannin Jr. will be the Browns' unquestioned top pass-catching TE in 2026 after his impressive rookie campaign.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Not tendered
metadata.description: Whiteheart was not tendered by the Browns, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart was a restricted free agent but will now enter the pool of unrestricted players able to be signed by any organization. The tight end played in all 17 regular-season games for the Browns in 2025, primarily playing a blocking role for both the offense and special-teams unit. The 25-year-old can be a strong No. 3 tight end for any team looking to build up its offensive trenches.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Enters restricted free agency
metadata.description: Whiteheart had two catches on six targets for four yards over 17 regular-season games in 2025.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart spent the entire season on the Browns' 53-man roster as the team's third tight end. Cleveland's tight ends turned out to be major targets, but he was never a factor in the passing attack, even in the final few games when injuries hit both David Njoku (knee) and Harold Fannin (groin). Whiteheart enters restricted free agency this offseason.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Leads TEs in snaps
metadata.description: Whiteheart was unable to secure his lone target over 32 snaps in Sunday's 13-6 win over the Steelers in Week 17.
metadata.analysis: It was just the fifth target in 16 games for Whiteheart, who has served mostly as a blocker this season. He led Browns tight ends in snaps after starter Harold Fannin (groin) was removed late in the first quarter. Whiteheart is not expected to gain a larger share of targets if the Browns decide to sit Fannin for the regular-season finale next Sunday against the Bengals. With Fannin sidelined for most of Week 17's contest, Sal Cannella led Cleveland's tight ends with four targets.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart sees one target in Week 14
metadata.description: Blake Whiteheart failed to catch his only target in the Browns' 31-29 loss to the Titans in Week 14.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart remains an afterthought in the Cleveland offense, recording one target or less in all 13 games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 15 contest against the Chicago Bears.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart - Logs full practice Thursday
metadata.description: Whiteheart (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart's practice snaps weren't capped during Thursday's session, which puts him on track to play against the Patriots on Sunday. The third-year tight end played 35 snaps on offense in Week 7 against the Dolphins, and his snap count could remain elevated for Week 8 if David Njoku (knee) is not cleared to play.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday
metadata.description: Blake Whiteheart (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being a limited participant on Wednesday due to a shoulder injury. He should be cleared to play for Sunday's game but won't see much work unless David Njoku (knee) is ruled out ahead of game time.

metadata.title: Blake Whiteheart (shoulder) listed as limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Blake Whiteheart (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Whiteheart is still dealing with a shoulder issue and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 8, but he will be set for a decrease in targets if David Njoku (knee) is back in the lineup for Cleveland.
